summary: 34 short videos covering all 110 verses, 4 stories
made_by: Research 2026-11-19: Saheeh translation, Al-Muyassar and As-Sa'di read verse by verse; durations from Quran Foundation word timings (Alafasy, plus 6.4 s intro/outro).
notes: All 110 verses match the second source (Tanzil) exactly; the only difference was the spacing of the sakt sign in 18:1, now a documented equivalence.

Yasser ad-Dussary joins verse 46 to verse 47 without any pause, so with him 45–46 and 47–49 are made as one video (45–49, about 2 minutes): the audio is never cut through the reciter's voice. With reciters who pause there, the two can stay separate.
Story scenes (cave, two gardens, ship, wall, the barrier) need new scene-library pieces before they look right. The calm-visual videos can be made now.
Where the two tafsirs differ (al-Khidr) or the picture could mislead (the setting sun, the masjid, the number of sleepers, Gog and Magog), follow the notes on each video.
Every video still needs a human review before publishing.

Word timings are checked against the audio: wherever the timing data puts a verse boundary while the reciter is still sounding, the boundary is moved onto the reciter's real, measured pause (with Dussary: 37 boundaries in Al-Kahf, 0.2–0.6 s each). These are listed on each review sheet.

Word-timing data is complete for every verse with Sudais, Husary, Minshawi (Murattal), Shuraym and Dussary. Alafasy is missing a word in 18:13 and 18:22; Hani ar-Rifai has defects in 32 verses. The app blocks any video that includes a defective verse.
